body: Run: python3 gpu/tools/frame_model.py --pixel gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/fsjobs/census-current-pf0.json gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/fsjobs/census-tilecap-pf1.json (existing fits/what-ifs untouched; your _ab hunk kept). Per job: F (per kernel job, not clock-scaled) + overlap(T_compute, T_bw); T_compute = (sum px*cover*c(shader) + preload px*0.5 + tiles*t_tile)/(9 cores*f*eff) + draws*t_draw; c(shader) from Mesa shaderdb of OUR compiled FS (BIFROST_MESA_DEBUG=shaderdb in the replay; G77 absent in Mesa -> G57 rates 2px/4tex/32fma per clk/core): fixed 0.5..1.0, luma 2.1..3.0, downsample 1.0..11, narrow 2.7..10 clk/fragment (range = LS weight 1/16..1); preload 0.5 (pixel-rate bound). T_bw = preload+write-back(+memory-fetch) bytes / BW. Calibration to c6jb (fs 5.75, rest 3.39 ms minus 2.5 ms IOSleep): t_tile from a today-style FS LOAD job, s_off scales replay offscreen pixels to the rest mean; data bound BW >= ~9.5 GB/s. Three parameter sets (optimistic/central/pessimistic). GPU ms/frame central [range]: before @350 today: tick 23 small 69 medium 147 large 250 ca200 99 blur 53 (device steady per cmd: small 84/15 jobs, medium 136/26 jobs, large 308/68 jobs - per-job consistent). After @350 P3+async: tick 1.8 [0.9-2.9], small 2.1 [1.4-3.0], medium 4.0 [3.9-4.2], large 7.2 [6.7-8.2], ca200 15.8 [15.7-17.2], blur 13.8 [12.2-15.8]; @654: 1.2 [0.8-1.6], 1.4 [1.1-1.7], 3.1 [2.4-3.6], 5.7 [4.3-6.9], 11.8 [10.3-13.2], 10.7 [9.7-11.4]; @886: 1.1, 1.2, 2.9, 5.2, 10.7, 9.8. Stress (display draws x4 px, all tiles covered, @654): 2.9/3.0/4.8/7.5/14.6/12.4. Without INTERSECT (tilecap pf0) @654: 2.9/2.9/4.6/6.9/13.9/12.3. Dominant 'after' term = F x jobs (13 jobs blur/12 ca200 are mostly offscreen CLEAR passes) -> F (unmeasured split of the 0.89 ms rest job) is the key unknown; kernel 0089 JOBS line (q_us/run_us/clean_us) will pin it. GPU only: encode ms and CA time are separate (pipelined frame = max). Census tool: gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/fsjobs/fsjobs.py.
